review_candidates.title: Corporate Account Manager
review_candidates.description: Location: Remote – Poland/Czechia/Germany or United Kingdom (ideally based near a major international airport) Company: NCH Europe – A Solenis Company NCH Industrial is seeking a highly driven Corporate Account Manager to help expand our Parts Cleaning and Industrial Maintenance business across Europe. This is a newly created role focused primarily on identifying, developing and winning new multinational manufacturing customers. Unlike a traditional account management position, this role is heavily focused on new business development and creating opportunities from the ground up. While the long-term vision is to build strategic corporate customer relationships across Europe, there are currently no established corporate accounts assigned to this position. Success will be driven by your ability to prospect, open doors, build relationships with key stakeholders and convert opportunities into sustainable business partnerships. As one of the first hires in this strategic initiative, you will play a key role in shaping how NCH Industrial develops multinational customer relationships across Europe. You will work closely with the President, Global Parts Cleaning & Industrial Maintenance, collaborate with country sales teams and help establish a scalable corporate business development model. Key Responsibilities Identify, target and win new multinational manufacturing customers across Europe. Develop and execute strategic business development plans focused on long-term revenue growth. Build relationships with key decision-makers across procurement, operations, engineering, maintenance and manufacturing functions. Create and manage a pipeline of new business opportunities within large multi-site industrial organisations. Lead commercial discussions, presentations, negotiations and contract development activities. Coordinate with country sales and technical teams to support customer evaluations, trials and implementations. Negotiate commercial agreements and framework contracts. Monitor business performance, track opportunities and provide regular forecasts and business updates to senior leadership. Represent NCH Industrial at customer meetings, industry events and trade exhibitions. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a commercially driven hunter with a proven track record of opening new business opportunities within industrial B2B environments. The ideal candidate will bring: 5+ years of experience in business development, strategic sales or corporate sales roles. Demonstrated success in winning new customers and developing business from scratch. Experience selling into manufacturing, industrial production or engineering environments. Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship-building skills. Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently and proactively. Confidence engaging with senior decision-makers across multinational organisations. Fluency in English; additional European languages are considered an advantage. Willingness to travel extensively across Europe (approximately 40–50%). A degree in Business, Engineering, Chemistry or a related discipline is advantageous but not essential. Why Join NCH Industrial? Role At NCH Industrial, we help manufacturing customers improve operational efficiency through innovative and sustainable Parts Cleaning and Industrial Maintenance solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to: Join a global organisation with strong technical expertise and ambitious growth plans. Build and shape a new European strategic business development function. Work closely with senior international leadership. Enjoy significant autonomy and ownership in developing new business opportunities. Influence the future growth of a key strategic business segment. Develop a long-term international career within a growing organisation. Interested? If you are motivated by winning new business, opening doors, building customer relationships from scratch and creating growth opportunities across Europe, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape the future growth of NCH Industrial’s European business.

review_candidates.title: Concreting Lead
review_candidates.description: An exciting opportunity has become available for a Concreter - Lead to join the Civil Construction Crew of Forbes Shire Council. Reporting directly to the Supervisor Construction and Maintenance. The aim of this position is to lead and deliver expert concreting work activities as part of the Civil Construction team within the Engineering Department, Works division of Council. This position will include expertise in planning, formwork, design plans and execution of concreting, kerb and guttering, paving and associated works This position will have accountability for mentoring, training and upskilling of all Council Team Leaders and operators in the area of civil concreting works. The role will also be responsible for continuous improvement in innovative technologies and industry developments as well as efficiency and work planning. Job Description To view a copy of the Job Description, please click HERE Desired Skills And Experience MORE ABOUT THE COMMUNITY Forbes is a vibrant town nestled on the Lachlan River and has the amazing Lake Forbes running through the centre of town. In a sought-after location, Forbes offers ease of access to Sydney via a 1-hour flight or a 3-hour drive to Canberra. We are also located halfway between the busy cities of Melbourne and Brisbane right on the Newell Highway boasting the benefits of country living with young families and couples who may want to work in Mining or construction as well as a thriving agricultural base. Forbes Council is a hive of activity, especially in regard to the operational delivery of projects to the community and the diversity within the workforce. With an Organisational Structure with close to 150 identified positions, roles range from Masters and Degree qualified professionals (Engineers, Surveyors, Planners and Accountants) to experienced labourers, trainees, trade qualified operators and a diverse range of officers in administration, Strategy, environment, economic development and community. Council offers flexible work arrangement, study support and a wide exposure to the legislative operations of Local Government through to community engagement and delivery. With a $50 million capitol works budget for the delivery of infrastructure and capital projects, Council is currently undertaking exciting projects such as the Goldridge Estate, subdivision development, Central West Industrial Park, Lake Forbes Activation Strategy, CBD redevelopment Projects, major works in regard to the Water and Sewer networks, our state-of-the art Central West Livestock Exchange and a range of other exciting projects. Forbes Shire Council is also currently delivering major projects in the People and Technology space including Leadership Development programs, online management software and enterprise-wide system upgrades - in the aim of being future ready for the dynamic and changing pace of Local Government. Our future plans are related to the IP&R framework in Local Government and our emphasis is in the areas of preservation, growth and development in Infrastructure and asset management, governance and leadership, community development and environment and heritage. We have ambitious goals set out in our Community Strategic Plan – paving the way for an ever changing and growing Forbes Shire, and Central West hub into the future. Forbes Council values vibrancy and energy, community partnerships, high quality delivery and the safest operations for our staff and the community. Come and be a part of our team! PRIVACY Forbes Shire Council, as part of the recruitment process will be collecting information about you. This information will be kept confidential and will only be accessible to the HR team and members of the interview panel. SELECTION PROCESS It is important that your application is completed by the closing date, the panel review committee are not obliged to accept late applications. All applications will be acknowledged. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY Council aims to ensure fair, equitable and non-discriminatory consideration for all applicants, regardless of sex, ethnic or racial origin, or physical disability. Forbes Shire Council's Selection Process Stages Are Outlined Below Shortlisting - The selection panel (usually 3 members) will assess all applications against the selection criteria contained in the position description. The panel will then decide which applicants best meet the criteria and will call for interview. Interview - You will be given at least 2-days' notice if you are required for an interview. The interview panel will consist of either 3 or 4 members, one of which will be the HR Facilitator, who will work with the panel to recommend the most suitable person for the position. Reference checks and other checks - Referee checks will be carried out on the recommended applicant/s. Positions that have been identified as child-related, will be required to undergo a Working with Children Check through the Office of Children's Guardian NSW Pre-employment Functional Assessment - The preferred applicant will be required to undergo a pre-employment functional assessment at Council’s expense. This will include a Functional Assessment, urine Drug and Alcohol Testing and a hearing screen Notification of the result - The successful applicant will be verbally notified as soon as possible after the interview and will receive a written letter of offer via email and in the post. Unsuccessful applicants will be notified by email once the offer of employment has been accepted and Council has been formally notified of the acceptance. Applications for this position close on Sunday 11 October 2026.

Organiser les formations nécessaires en Conformité et en AML/CFT au personnel de l’EdP Organiser et coordonner les reportings ainsi que tous les outils de suivi et de prévention du dispositif de conformité Rédiger et veiller à la mise en application des procédures AML/CFT. Fournir les réponses aux requêtes de l’ANRF Répondre aux réquisitions judiciaires émanant de la banque centrale Fournir des réponses aux requêtes de la CNASNU Réaliser les diligences nécessaires aux déclarations de soupçon Contrôler la bonne application des embargos et autres sanctions. Votre profil : Formation : Bac+5 en Audit, Finance ou dans un domaine similaire, issu(e) d’une école de commerce. Expérience : Minimum 2 ans d’expérience dans un poste similaire, idéalement au sein d’un établissement de paiement. Vos atouts : Réglementation bancaire Vision transversale métiers Connaissance des produits et services bancaires Excellentes compétences en communication (écrite et orale) Rigueur, autonomie et esprit d’initiative Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et exigeant Pourquoi ce poste est fait pour vous ? En rejoignant Orange Maroc, vous participerez activement à la transformation digitale d’un leader du marché. Vous intégrerez une équipe soudée et passionnée, dans un environnement où vos compétences et votre potentiel seront pleinement valorisés. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever le défi ? Envoyez-nous votre candidature et rejoignez une aventure professionnelle unique ! Rejoignez-nous, où la diversité et l’excellence se rencontrent !

You will be responsible for ensuring the administrative management and development of Human Resources in compliance with Algerian labour legislation, Eni Group policies and procedures, and the company's internal policies. You will also oversee the effective management of local and expatriate employees, workforce planning, skills development, and business travel arrangements. About Eni Algeria Production B.V. Eni Algeria, a key subsidiary of the Eni group, has been a prominent player in the exploration, development, and production of hydrocarbons and natural gas in Algeria since 1981. As the leading international energy company in the region. Present in the areas of Berkine, In Amenas, In Salah, and more recently in Touat, Eni Algeria is dedicated to increasing and diversifying gas export flows to Europe and Italy through its long-standing partnerships. Employees at Eni Algeria benefit from a dynamic and inclusive work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and a strong commitment to sustainability and innovation, making it an excellent place to build a rewarding career. Main Responsibilities Personnel Administration: Manage all aspects of personnel administration for local and expatriate employees, ensuring compliance with labour legislation and company policies. Expatriate Management: Oversee expatriate administration, including visas, work permits, residency requirements, and related employee support. Workforce Planning & Recruitment: Support workforce planning, recruitment activities, and the onboarding of new employees. Training & Development: Coordinate training programmes and initiatives to support employee development and organisational capability. Travel Management: Supervise business travel arrangements and ensure compliance with travel policies and approved budgets. Policies, Procedures & Compliance: Ensure adherence to HR policies, legal requirements, and internal procedures while maintaining effective relationships with relevant authorities. Reporting & Management Support: Prepare HR reports, monitor key workforce metrics, and provide insights and recommendations to support management decision-making. Skills And Experience Required Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Law, or a related field. Proven experience in Human Resources management, ideally including team supervision or coordination. Strong knowledge of Algerian labour legislation and HR administration practices. Experience in workforce planning, recruitment, training, and employee lifecycle management. Experience managing expatriate employees, immigration processes, and business travel arrangements is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR information systems. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. High level of discretion and commitment to confidentiality. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships at all levels. Leadership skills with the ability to coordinate teams and stakeholders. Diplomatic approach and ability to handle sensitive matters professionally. Proactive mindset, sound judgement, and a results-oriented approach. Fluency in French and English. How To Apply Applications are only accepted through our online application system. Please upload your CV in English. About Eni Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions. Working at Eni At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual , continuous training , and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well-being, welfare and work life-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process . Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen. Energy for action takers
